text: On September 14, 2020, the Corporations Nominating Panel conducted interviews and recommended three candidates to City Council for appointment to the CreateTO Board.

City Council on September 30, October 1 and 2, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following public members to the CreateTO Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on October 2, 2024, and until successors are appointed: Marni Dicker Dennis Fotinos Sandra Levy 2. City Council appoint the following public members to the Boards of Directors of Build Toronto and the Port Lands Company, at the pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on October 2, 2022, and until successors are appointed: Marni Dicker Dennis Fotinos Sandra Levy 3. City Council appoint the following public members of CreateTO for re-appointment to Build Toronto and the Toronto Port Lands Company, at the pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on December 31, 2021, and until successors are appointed: Ron Carinci Marcie Zajdeman 4.
